source: NOAA NHC GIS (KMZ) + Tropical Weather Outlook

outlook.discussion: 1. Southwestern Gulf of America: A surface trough of low pressure has developed along the coast of Mexico in the southwestern Gulf of America. Although environmental conditions are expected to be only marginally conducive, gradual development of this system is possible and a tropical depression could form by the second half of this week while it initially drifts eastward before turning northward. Formation chance through 48 hours...low...10 percent. Formation chance through 7 days...medium...50 percent.

1. South of Southern Mexico: A broad area of low pressure located just to the south of the Gulf of Tehuantepec is currently producing scattered showers and thunderstorm activity. Environmental conditions appear favorable for gradual development, and a tropical depression is expected to form during the middle to latter portion of the week while the system moves slowly west-northwestward to northwestward, just offshore of the southern to southwestern coast of Mexico. Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...40 percent. Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.
